about: What a take paid is what the fold says it paid: an answer pays a demand only over the coordinates its take judged. A batch landed twice judges again each of its demands the fold still counts unpaid, and a gate that watches takes counts only those landed after the first gate ran; a demand signed again keeps its history, and history is never counted as a take without gates.

red was: a take was matched to a demand by scope alone: the owner's two demands signed again at 212 read as taken without gates by takes that predate every gate, and a batch re-run would have skipped a demand a take of an older signing had answered
